title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
summary: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.
reason: Survey-based commentary on managers' difficulties evaluating employee work with AI. No named model release, no research artifact, no business/financing/M&A event, no policy action, and no open-source tool release; no rule covers it.
